description: Sifa's own statement that it verified a person's employment. Written only by Sifa's published issuer account, about someone else, the way a trusted verifier writes app.bsky.graph.verification. Consumers trust the issuer DID, not the repository the record appears in: a copy of this record in any other repository carries no meaning.

main.description: Record issued by Sifa stating that it verified the subject's employment in a position. Only records authored by the issuer DID count. Deleting the record is a revocation; status and method changes update the same record. expiresAt is set only while a current position rests on email verification alone. The record carries method tokens only, never an email address or domain. Absence of a record is not a negative signal.

subject.description: DID of the person whose employment was verified.

position.description: The subject's id.sifa.profile.position record. Resolve the AT-URI live; the CID is an integrity hint.

status.description: Whether the verified employment is current or past.

methods.description: Every method that currently backs this verification.

title.description: Job title snapshot from the position at issue time. Consumers compare it with the live position to notice edits.

startedAt.description: Start date snapshot in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

endedAt.description: End date in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format when status is past.

entityRef.description: Portable identifier (Wikidata Q-ID URI, ROR URI, or LEI URI) of the employing legal entity, when known.

organization.description: DID of the organization's account, when the organization is on the network.

evidence.description: Public records that back the verification, such as the organization's id.sifa.org.employmentAttestation. Never private evidence.

verifiedAt.description: When the most recent backing verification was made.

expiresAt.description: When this verification lapses unless renewed. Present only while a current position rests on email verification alone. Consumers treat a record past this time as lapsed.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was created.
